title: Clean up uncompiled dead modules in vendored/external rust-oscore source
description: From project-LICHEN-worker6-s549 codereview (item 3): the vendored crate rust/crates/oscore/src and the external clone /home/mark/crates/oscore both carry modules with no mod declaration in lib.rs (context.rs, protect.rs, unprotect.rs, option.rs, crypto.rs, group.rs, types.rs, tests.rs) - stale copies of superseded window-helper designs that misled codereview greps. Deleting them in the EXTERNAL clone and pushing upstream needs Mark's explicit authorization (upstream push policy); the vendored in-tree copy could be cleaned independently but should stay byte-identical to its declared upstream lineage until then. Owner decision required: (a) delete dead modules in both trees + bump manifest version 0.1.0 -> 0.1.2 (vendored manifest was not bumped at vendoring, see s549), or (b) leave and document. Also tracked in patches/README.md.
